video_title: Ime Udoka: Rockets Will "Make Some Real Noise" | Chris Mannix & Evan Turner

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Can the Houston Rockets compete for an NBA championship this season?
quotes.excerpt: Is this a team that can compete for a championship?
quotes.quote: What do you think is the ceiling for the Houston Rockets? Do you think this Rockets team, with the changes they made the offseason, how healthy they get going into this season, is this a team that can compete for a championship?

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Smart's toughness and energy impact on the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Marcus Smart, even though he has his moments, he does have toughness, championship toughness

text_blocks.speaker: Evan Turner
text_blocks.text: They added little pieces that can provide fight when things are dwindling. So Marcus Smart, even though he has his moments, he does have toughness, championship toughness and he plays with a certain energy that is going to get you over top in my personal opinion. Anytime you're playing with Kevin Durant or anything like that, I feel as though you need other guys to do the dirty work. And I feel like when they lost Dylan Brooks, that was like a piece that could have got them over the top in a sense of playoffs or made certain games more serious.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The Houston Rockets' roster pieces needed to compete in the West
quotes.excerpt: To me, they absolutely can compete for a championship. Like, think about what you need
quotes.quote: To me, they absolutely can compete for a championship. Like, think about what you need to get through the Western Conference. You need big bodies to deal with Victor Wembanyama. You've got Alperen Sengun and you've got Steven Adams. You need defensive-minded wings to deal with Oklahoma City. You get Amen Thompson, you've got Tari Eason, you've got Jabari Smith, you've got Jayson Tatum, you've got Marcus Smart. You've got those. What I think the Rockets' success is going to come down to is a couple of things.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's health and performance are critical for the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Is Fred VanVleet the same player or better than he was before the injury?
quotes.quote: One, is Fred VanVleet the same player or better than he was before the injury? They missed Fred VanVleet last year, man. They missed him a lot more than I thought they were going to miss him because I thought that Amen Thompson would be perfectly adequate as a playmaker. And look, he was fine. He just doesn't have the requisite experience to slow the game down and to understand what to do in big moments.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Reed Sheppard's potential to emerge as a key sixth man
quotes.excerpt: Can Reed Sheppard emerge as one of the better sixth men in the NBA?
quotes.quote: Can Reed Sheppard take a jump? Like Reed Sheppard got that, you know, the mustache going, he's a little bit more bulked up, he's bumped into a sixth man role. All these Instagram videos of the offseason, looks like he's made some steps. Like can he emerge as one of the better sixth men in the NBA? Can he become the supershooter that he was believed to be coming into the draft?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Steven Adams' health is vital for the Rockets' frontcourt
quotes.excerpt: Steven Adams has been chronically injured with these season-ending injuries during his career
quotes.quote: Steven Adams has been chronically injured with these season-ending injuries during his career. That's some bad injuries in recent years. They need Steven Adams. Not to play next to Alperen Sengun necessarily, though Ime Udoka seems to love that lineup, I don't think it's great. You need him though when it comes down to playing Victor Wembanyama, to matching up with Isaiah Hartenstein, to playing against Nikola Jokic. It can't just be Alperen Sengun and Jabari Smith in that frontcourt.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of vocal veteran leadership for the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Last year I felt like Alperen Sengun would have been able to adapt more in playmaker role
quotes.quote: Last year I felt like Alperen Sengun would have been able to adapt more in playmaker role if there was more vocal leaders around. I think there was a couple of vets around and a lot of young guys still trying to find their footing underneath them. I feel like a lot was kind of got lost, especially when you're trying to keep control of a locker room.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Turner's skepticism about Fred VanVleet as a championship point guard
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if Fred VanVleet is a championship point guard
quotes.quote: I don't know if Fred VanVleet is a championship point guard. But he does have a situation where I think if Ime Udoka comes out, Reed Sheppard could be a sixth man or vice versa, but they can kind of share the starting role, lead guard role, sixth man role depending on how the game is going to go.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's shooting struggles and the need for improvement
quotes.excerpt: He shot 37.8% last year, that was the lowest since his rookie season
quotes.quote: He shot 37.8% last year, that was the lowest since his rookie season, the lowest in any full season. That's got to come up. Like he's never been a high-percentage shooter in any way. Like his career high is like 42.6%.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Turner on the difficulty of shooting 20 shots in an NBA game
quotes.excerpt: Coming from a dude who got killed for analytics, I remember I used to be shooting
quotes.quote: Coming from a dude who got killed for analytics, I remember I used to be shooting and being like, there's two people, him and Marcus Smart. I say, bro, do you know how good you got to be to shoot 20 shots in an NBA game? When I watch him hoop, I'm not mad, but I'm like, do you know how good you have to be to shoot the shots he shoots?
